description: Find individual usage records — one per API response — matching a model substring, providers, project, date range and per-record cost bounds. Returns up to `limit` records (default 25), newest first unless sort_by says cost or tokens, each with time, provider, model, project, token buckets and cost. Use it to investigate a specific spike or an expensive call; for totals use tokmeter_pulse, for per-model or per-project rollups use tokmeter_models or tokmeter_projects. Records exist only while agents keep their transcripts, so the default (all) scope covers the last 14 days.

scope.description: Time scope: today, week (last 7d), month (calendar month), or all (default)

since.description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD) for custom date range

sort_by.description: Sort by cost (desc), tokens (desc), or time (desc). Default: time

until.description: End date (YYYY-MM-DD) for custom date range

name: tokmeter_search
